page.overview:
What is Eight Nine Island?

Eight Nine Island is a island mentioned by Rice Rice. It is said that it grows Thousand-Year Trees, which is what Thousand-Year Paper is made of.

Not much is known about the island's geography other than that the Thousand-Year Trees grow there.

It is unknown if there are any inhabitants on the island.

Nothing is known about the island's history since it has yet to make an appearance.
